lib='''def find_blocks(grid, exclude=(0,)):
    """All top-left corners of 2x2 (or nxn) solid squares of one color, excluding background colors."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v not in exclude and all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == v for dr in (0, 1) for dc in (0, 1)):
                out.append((r, c))
    return out

def block_cells(blocks):
    """The set of all cells covered by the given 2x2 blocks (top-left corners)."""
    return {(r + dr, c + dc) for r, c in blocks for dr in (0, 1) for dc in (0, 1)}

def rot90cw(dr, dc):
    """Rotate an (row, col) offset 90 degrees clockwise: (dc, -dr)."""
    return dc, -dr

def diagonal_ray(grid, center_r, center_c, dr, dc, occupied=()):
    """Paint, in place is False: return list of cells on the diagonal from just outside any
    occupied cells outward in direction (dr, dc) from the given center, clipped to the grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    s = (1 if dr > 0 else -1, 1 if dc > 0 else -1)
    i, j = round(center_r + dr), round(center_c + dc)
    if not (0 <= i < h and 0 <= j < w) or (i, j) in occupied:
        return []
    while 0 <= i - s[0] < h and 0 <= j - s[1] < w and (i - s[0], j - s[1]) not in occupied:
        i -= s[0]; j -= s[1]
    cells = []
    while 0 <= i < h and 0 <= j < w:
        cells.append((i, j)); i += s[0]; j += s[1]
    return cells

def paint(grid, cells, color):
    """A copy of the grid with the given (r, c) cells recolored."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        if 0 <= r < len(g) and 0 <= c < len(g[0]):
            g[r][c] = color
    return g
